samples.question: The gold two-cell bracket shows the blur span. The cyan 9-by-9 mosaic is a horizontal two-exposure blur of one coral reference card: each displayed tile is the average of the source tile at that position and the source tile immediately to its left, using blank beyond the left edge. Undo the blur from left to right without rotating or reflecting. Which reference card is the source? Cards A, B, C, and D are arranged left to right.
